beats: Hook: DeepSeek runs its training pipeline in both directions at once, like two trains crossing without colliding.
Recap: the bubble is (N-1)/M, and micro-batches cannot get smaller than one sequence.
Interleaving (Megatron-LM 2021): each GPU holds two or more non-adjacent chunks of layers, so a micro-batch goes round the line twice; bubble = (N-1)/(M x L).
The cost: L times more messages, and with layers mixed in time the DP side keeps whole gradients (ZeRO-1).
In practice: interleaved 1F1B with L = 2-4 is the Megatron-Core default.
Zero Bubble (ICLR 2024): backward = input gradient (urgent: the stage before is waiting) + weight gradient (can wait); slide the weight work into the gaps.
Scheduling is a packing puzzle: an exact solver at small scale, heuristics at large; fewer messages than interleaving for similar bubbles.
DualPipe (DeepSeek-V3): two pipelines run in opposite directions and fill each other's gaps, paid for with two copies of the parameters.
Takeaway: every schedule trades bubbles against memory or messages: a baker juggling a soap bubble, a binder and a note.

drawings.prompt: Seen from slightly above and in front: a round carousel conveyor, a ring-shaped counter with a moving belt on top, with small cupcakes in little trays spaced evenly all the way round it. The four bakers are invented characters with simple round faces and dot eyes, all in plain white aprons over rolled-up sleeves and small flat paper baker's caps (not tall chef hats): the first is tall and thin with round glasses; the second has a long ponytail; the third is short and sturdy with curly hair; the fourth has a neat bob haircut and freckles. The four bakers stand around the outside of the ring at four evenly spaced points (front left, back left, back right, front right), each working on the cupcake in front of them. Some cupcakes on the belt are plain, some have icing, some have icing and a cherry on top, showing that they go round more than once. Square image 1024x1024; the ring and the bakers fill about 90% of the width, centred. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
